title: The explicit lower spectral endpoint for finite connected non-bipartite vertex-transitive graphs with at least four vertices
author: Arindam Biswas; Jyoti Prakash Saha
work: A spectral bound for vertex-transitive graphs and their spanning subgraphs
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics6(3)(2023),689–706; exact official publisher native DOI10.5802/alco.278
difficulty_reason: The normalized Cheeger conversion at the end is standard, but the selected lower endpoint still requires the authors quantitative overlap dichotomy, construction of a proper index-two subgroup from large intersection sets, stabilizer-size fibre estimates, two-orbit intersection counting and forced bipartition contradiction. The complete175–835 chain adapts the group arguments to vertex-transitive graphs and yields the explicit square-graph expansion constant; it is retained as a new substantive construction rather than assumed as a bridge. Only the lower endpoint is selected, with no diameter, irregular-spanning or nearly-transitive helper count.
